title: Agreement between subject and verb (1)
summary: Согласование подлежащего и глагола: собирательные существительные (the team is / are), подлежащее с and, or / nor, with / as well as, существительные на -s, суммы, расстояния и названия.
ru:
## Принцип: глагол согласуется с ядром подлежащего
Правило кажется простым: единственное число → *is / has / works*, множественное → *are / have / work*. Сложности начинаются, когда форма слова и его смысл расходятся, или когда подлежащее состоит из нескольких частей.

## Собирательные существительные: team, committee, government, staff
Слова, обозначающие группу людей (**team, family, committee, government, staff, audience, council, jury**), в британском варианте могут иметь глагол и в единственном, и во множественном числе.
- **Единственное число** — группа как единое целое: *The committee **has** reached a decision.*
- **Множественное число** — акцент на отдельных людях в группе: *The committee **are** divided on the issue.* — Члены комитета расходятся во мнениях.
В американском английском обычно ставят **единственное** число: *The team **is** ready.* Если дальше стоит местоимение, в аккуратной письменной речи его согласуют с глаголом: The team **is** playing well and **it** is sure to win. / The team **are** playing well and **they** are sure to win. (В разговорной речи *The team is ... they* встречается часто, особенно в американском варианте.)
Слова **police, people, cattle** всегда требуют множественного числа: *The police **have** arrested a suspect.*

## Подлежащее с and
Два подлежащих, связанные **and**, обычно дают множественное число: *My manager and her assistant **are** away.* Но есть исключения.
- Если **and** соединяет то, что воспринимается как **одно понятие**, глагол стоит в единственном числе: *Fish and chips **is** my favourite meal.* / *Bread and butter **is** all we had.*
- **each / every / no + существительное**: *Every student and teacher **has** been informed.* (единственное)
- Если речь о **одном человеке** с двумя ролями (артикль один): *The founder and CEO **is** speaking tonight.* — это один человек; а *The founder and the CEO **are** speaking* — это двое.

## or, nor, either … or, neither … nor
Глагол согласуется с **ближайшим** подлежащим:
> Neither the manager nor the **employees were** satisfied. — Ни менеджер, ни сотрудники не были довольны.
> Either the employees or the **manager is** responsible.
В разговорной речи при **neither … nor** с местоимениями допускают множественное число: *Neither he nor I **are** going* (формально — *am*).

## with, as well as, together with, along with
Эти слова **не** образуют сложного подлежащего: глагол согласуется с первым существительным.
> The director, **together with** his advisers, **is** attending the summit. — Директор вместе с советниками участвует в саммите.
> The students, as well as their teacher, **were** late.

## Существительные на -s и особые случаи
- **Единственное число**: *news, economics, physics, politics, measles, athletics; a pair of trousers*.
- **Множественное число**: *trousers, scissors, glasses, clothes, goods, arms*.
- **Суммы, расстояния, время** как единое целое: *Ten thousand dollars **is** a lot of money. Three miles **is** too far to walk. Two hours **isn't** enough.*
- **Названия, заголовки**: *The Netherlands **is** a small country. The Simpsons **has** been on TV for decades.*

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~The news are bad.~~ → The news **is** bad.
- ~~The manager, as well as his assistants, are late.~~ → The manager, as well as his assistants, **is** late.
- ~~Ten euros are too much.~~ → Ten euros **is** too much.
en:
## The principle: the verb agrees with the head of the subject
The rule looks easy: singular → *is / has / works*, plural → *are / have / work*. Problems start when the form of a word and its meaning do not match, or when the subject has several parts.

## Collective nouns: team, committee, government, staff
Words for groups of people (**team, family, committee, government, staff, audience, council, jury**) can take a singular or a plural verb in British English.
- **Singular** — the group as a single unit: *The committee **has** reached a decision.*
- **Plural** — the individual members: *The committee **are** divided on the issue.*
In American English a **singular** verb is normal: *The team **is** ready.* In careful writing, keep pronouns consistent with the verb (in conversation *The team is ... they* is common, especially in American English): The team **is** playing well and **it** is sure to win. / The team **are** playing well and **they** are sure to win.
The words **police, people, cattle** are always plural: *The police **have** arrested a suspect.*

## Subjects joined by and
Two subjects joined by **and** usually take a plural verb: *My manager and her assistant **are** away.* But there are exceptions.
- When **and** joins what is thought of as **one idea**, the verb is singular: *Fish and chips **is** my favourite meal.*
- **each / every / no + noun**: *Every student and teacher **has** been informed.*
- One person with two roles (one article): *The founder and CEO **is** speaking tonight.* Two people (two articles): *The founder and the CEO **are** speaking.*

## or, nor, either … or, neither … nor
The verb agrees with the **nearest** subject:
> Neither the manager nor the **employees were** satisfied.
> Either the employees or the **manager is** responsible.

## with, as well as, together with, along with
These phrases do **not** form a compound subject; the verb agrees with the first noun.
> The director, **together with** his advisers, **is** attending the summit.
> The students, as well as their teacher, **were** late.

## Nouns in -s and special cases
- **Singular**: *news, economics, physics, politics, measles, athletics; a pair of trousers*.
- **Plural**: *trousers, scissors, glasses, clothes, goods, arms*.
- **Sums, distances, time** as a single unit: *Ten thousand dollars **is** a lot of money. Three miles **is** too far to walk.*
- **Names and titles**: *The Netherlands **is** a small country. The Simpsons **has** been on TV for decades.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~The news are bad.~~ → The news **is** bad.
- ~~The manager, as well as his assistants, are late.~~ → The manager, as well as his assistants, **is** late.
- ~~Ten euros are too much.~~ → Ten euros **is** too much.
structure:
## Собирательные существительные
| Слово | Британский вариант | Американский вариант |
|---|---|---|
| team, committee, family | is / are (смысл) | is |
| police, people, cattle | are | are |
| staff, audience, jury | is / are | is |

## Составное подлежащее
| Конструкция | Глагол | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| A and B | мн. число | Tom and Ann **are** here. |
| A and B (одно понятие) | ед. число | Fish and chips **is** cheap. |
| each / every + A and B | ед. число | Every man and woman **was** asked. |
| A or B / neither A nor B | по ближайшему | Neither he nor they **were** there. |
| A with / as well as B | по первому (A) | Tom, as well as Ann, **is** late. |

## Особые случаи
| Тип | Правило | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| news, economics | ед. число | The news **is** good. |
| trousers, scissors | мн. число | My trousers **are** torn. |
| a pair of trousers | ед. число | A pair of trousers **is** on the bed. |
| суммы, расстояния | ед. число | Five miles **is** a long way. |
| название-множественное | ед. число | The Philippines **is** hot. |

exercises.title: is или are?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужную форму глагола **be** или **have** (время ясно из предложения).
exercises.example: The news ___ good. → The news **is** good.

items.text: The police {{are}} looking for the missing painting.
Neither the teacher nor the students {{were}} aware of the change yesterday.
Bread and butter {{is}} a simple but filling snack.
Every manager and employee {{has}} to complete the course.
Three weeks {{is}} too long to wait for an answer.
Either the dean or the lecturers {{are}} responsible for this decision.
The Netherlands {{is}} famous for its canals.

exercises.title: Собирательные существительные
exercises.instruction: Вставьте форму глагола в скобках. Принято британское употребление: если допустимы единственное и множественное число, перечислите оба варианта.

items.text: The audience {{was|were}} deeply moved by the performance.
The cattle {{are}} grazing in the field.
The committee {{has|have}} not yet reached a decision.
The people next door {{are}} very noisy.
My family {{is|are}} planning a trip to Spain.

exercises.title: Выберите правильную форму
exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, в котором глагол согласован с подлежащим.

items.q: The director, together with her colleagues, ___ attending the conference.
items.why: together with не образует сложного подлежащего; глагол согласуется с director.

items.q: Fish and chips ___ a traditional British dish.
items.why: Два слова воспринимаются как одно блюдо: единственное число.

items.q: Neither Anna nor her brothers ___ ready to leave.
items.why: Глагол согласуется с ближайшим подлежащим — brothers.

items.q: Ten kilometres ___ a long walk after work.
items.why: Расстояние как единое целое: единственное число.

items.q: The police ___ not released the suspect's name yet.
Physics ___ my favourite subject at school.
My trousers ___ too short for me now.
items.why: trousers — множественное число (в отличие от a pair of trousers).

exercises.title: Найдите верное предложение
exercises.instruction: Выберите предложение без ошибки в согласовании.

options: The manager, as well as his assistants, are late.
The manager, as well as his assistants, is late.
The manager, as well as his assistants, were late.
items.why: as well as не создаёт сложного подлежащего: manager → is.

options: Every student and teacher have been told.
Every student and teacher has been told.
Every student and teacher are told.
items.why: После every подлежащее воспринимается как единственное число.

options: A pair of scissors are on the desk.
A pair of scissors is on the desk.
A pair of scissors were on the desk.
items.why: Подлежащее — pair; оно в единственном числе.

options: Neither the manager nor the engineers is available.
Neither the manager nor the engineers are available.
Neither the manager nor the engineers am available.
The news about the strike were alarming.
The news about the strike was alarming.
The news about the strike are alarming.
Five hundred pounds are too much to pay.
Five hundred pounds is too much to pay.
Five hundred pounds were too much to pay.
items.why: Сумма денег как единое целое — единственное число.

exercises.title: Соедините предложения
exercises.instruction: Соедините два предложения в одно с указанным союзом. Следите за глаголом.

items.prompt: The director is on holiday. The deputy directors are on holiday too. (as well as) → The director, ...
answers: The director, as well as the deputy directors, is on holiday.
The director, as well as his deputies, is on holiday.
The director, as well as the deputy directors, is on holiday too.
The director, as well as her deputies, is on holiday.

items.prompt: The captain was not injured. The players were not injured. (neither ... nor) → Neither the captain ...
answers: Neither the captain nor the players were injured.

items.prompt: Tom is responsible. Or his sisters are responsible. (either ... or) → Either Tom ...
answers: Either Tom or his sisters are responsible.

items.prompt: The teacher is in the room. The students are in the room. (along with) → The teacher, ...
answers: The teacher, along with the students, is in the room.
The teacher, along with his students, is in the room.
The teacher, along with her students, is in the room.

items.prompt: Every teacher has a parking pass. Every student has one too. (every ... and ...) → Every ...
answers: Every teacher and student has a parking pass.
Every teacher and every student has a parking pass.

items.prompt: The manager is not surprised. The employees are not surprised. (neither ... nor) → Neither the manager ...
answers: Neither the manager nor the employees are surprised.

exercises.title: Исправьте ошибки
exercises.instruction: В каждом предложении есть ошибка согласования. Перепишите предложение верно.

items.prompt: The news about the election were unexpected.
answers: The news about the election was unexpected.

items.prompt: Three miles are too far for me to run.
answers: Three miles is too far for me to run.

items.prompt: The police is investigating the burglary.
answers: The police are investigating the burglary.

items.prompt: Neither the pilot nor the passengers was injured.
answers: Neither the pilot nor the passengers were injured.

items.prompt: Mathematics are my daughter's favourite subject.
answers: Mathematics is my daughter's favourite subject.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложения с согласованием по образцу.

items.prompt: Напишите предложение с названием команды, группы или организации (the team / the company ...).
items.sample: The company I work for has about fifty employees.

items.prompt: Напишите предложение с neither ... nor про ваших друзей или родственников.
items.sample: Neither my brother nor my parents like spicy food.

items.prompt: Напишите предложение с as well as.
items.sample: My sister, as well as her husband, speaks three languages.

items.prompt: Напишите про расстояние или время (Ten minutes / Five kilometres ...).
items.sample: Ten minutes is enough time for me to get to work.
